text:
mira: All-hands is starting now! Stream link: https://meet.redwood.ai/184 — drop your live-chat hot takes and emojis :tada:
toni: @mira bringing virtual snacks. who wants a cookie? :cookie:
sam: :clap: hype. mic check 1-2
deploy-bot: Recording will be available in #all-hands after the meeting.
anna: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/applause-clap — this sums up the engineering wins :raised_hands:
ryan: slow clap. also prepared my ukulele for the post-show serenade :guitar:
emily: snack poll: pizza 🍕 or dumplings 🥟? react with :pizza: or :dumpling:
sam: pizza :pizza:
toni: dumplings :dumpling:
mira: Quick shoutout to infra for the midnight deploy — flawless. big love :heart:
ryan: standing ovation irl and in chat :raised_hands: :clap:
emily: who snuck the cat slide into product updates? 10/10 branding decision (cats > charts)
anna: @ryan you promised karaoke if we hit Q2 goals. don't back out now :microphone:
ryan: I said no singing, only atmospheric ukulele accompaniment. subtle but powerful.
deploy-bot: :loud_sound: Meeting recording started.
toni: also, who wants to coordinate an office potluck next Friday? vote with emojis.
mira: pls mute unless you're on camera for Q&A. exceptions: ukulele, enthusiastic cheering, and emily's cat commentary.
sam: emoji spam incoming :confetti_ball: :tada: :sparkles:
emily: someone put confetti on slide 14 and now it's a mood.
anna: any parents watching the stream — say hi in chat! :wave:
ryan: never muted, always dramatic. :sunglasses:
toni: posting a ridiculous celebratory GIF in #random after this. you have been warned.
mira: final quick poll: after-party—virtually meet for 30m or post on #after-hours memes? reply "virt" or "memes"
sam: memes
emily: virt if there are dumplings
anna: memes for sure
ryan: virt for ukulele
deploy-bot: Meeting will be auto-closed in 2 hours. Thanks for attending! :robot_face:
mira: thanks all — love the energy. see you at the Q&A and the questionable jokes afterwards :smile:
